description: Designs a mobile app for iOS and Android with the person, the free step before a build. Send one sentence as idea to create a new app, pages by purpose as map, or a short plan or a full design as app, and get back a link that opens it in the Architect as a new, unsaved design: the person sees every screen, changes it and hands it back for emit_app. The link and its code last 7 days. format: true returns the format; dryRun checks without making a link; into sends it to the design the person has open.

app.description: A short plan, e.g. {"version":1,"opening":"tabs","tabs":[{"template":"list","name":"Walks"},{"template":"settings","name":"Settings"}]}, or a full design. With format: true, a plan's format (its templates) or, without a plan, the full design's.

dryRun.description: check the design and report, without making a link

format.description: true for the format; "photos" for sample photos

idea.description: what the app is for, in the person's words

into.description: the design code in the person's line

map.description: as open_app gives it; format: "map" for its lists

name: propose_app
title: Propose an app design
